title: nwc-1998-world
label: "Excellence in Ebony" Avalon Britton

won.source: The promotion's own Face Off at High Noon 2 supercard.

note: Left the arena with his allies immediately after winning, without waiting for the formal announcement.

won.source: Already champion entering the earliest attestation in the held record (14 April 1999); no document in the held record records when or how he won it.

lost.source: The promotion's own Face Off at High Noon 2 supercard: Avalon Britton pinned him with a fast count from a referee revealed to be aligned with Britton's own allies, after a second referee's own clean three-count was broken up by outside interference.
